components.intent: Organize the workshop as a U-shaped assembly whose two approach wings frame an open arrival court and terminate at a broad fabrication shed.
Form a wide double-height fabrication shed across the rear of the court, directly accessible from both flanking wings.
Place a compact upper studio bar along the rear edge of the fabrication shed for direct vertical circulation and visual oversight.
Guide visitors from the primary approach along one side of the open court into the fabrication hall through a dedicated exhibition wing.
Provide an independent loading wing on the opposite side of the court with direct adjacency to the fabrication shed.

constraint_responses.rationale: No bounded net-area allocation is established by the supplied records; the proposal therefore preserves net area as unresolved while using an 1800-square-metre coarse footprint within the declared range.

proposal.label: Open-Court Workshop with Opposed Public and Service Wings
proposal.rationale: The 1800-square-metre footprint forms a materially different open-court topology: the fabrication hall spans the rear, while narrow public and service wings project independently toward the primary approach and remain separated by a three-cell-deep court. The public wing terminates directly at the hall, the service wing maintains required loading adjacency on the opposite side, and the upper studio bar occupies the hall's rear edge to provide the required vertical working link without recreating the excluded compact stacked-edge arrangement.
proposal.typology_hypothesis: A U-shaped workshop court with a broad rear fabrication shed, an upper overlook studio bar, and two narrow approach wings that spatially separate public exhibition movement from service loading.

components.intent: Organize the workshop as one rooted assembly with a tall fabrication core, upper studios, and separated public and service edges.
Provide the primary double-height fabrication volume and the spatial focus of the workshop.
Stack studio accommodation above and alongside the fabrication hall to support a direct vertical working relationship.
Create a public-facing exhibition threshold connected to the fabrication hall and isolated from loading activity.
Consolidate service and loading beside the fabrication hall on the edge opposite the public exhibition approach.

constraint_responses.rationale: The supplied records do not establish a bounded net-area allocation, so net area remains unresolved while the 1500-square-metre coarse footprint stays within the declared footprint range.

existing_option_projection.label: Stacked Fabrication Hall with Separated Public and Service Edges
existing_option_projection.rationale: The option uses a 1500-square-metre coarse footprint at the lower bound of the declared range. The fabrication hall occupies the central tall volume, upper studios overlap its upper massing to express the required vertical link, the exhibition zone forms a public-facing edge, and loading remains adjacent to fabrication while separated from the public route.
existing_option_projection.typology_hypothesis: A compact workshop organized around a tall fabrication hall, with studios stacked over the production core and public exhibition and service-loading bars separated along opposing edges.

alternative_context.instructions: Author a complete independent alternative with a new option_id and meaningfully different spatial topology. Do not rename, patch, or select the existing option.

payload.instructions: Author one schematic option from only the supplied current records. Create the existing DesignComponent tree and its coarse massing volumes in the same proposal. Every volume must have exactly one component owner. Preserve project evidence references and return only the required output object; do not select, persist, execute, or claim validation.

every volume id exists and is owned by exactly one component
component and volume source refs are present in evidence_refs
proposal authority fields equal proposal_fixed_values exactly

each connection joins zones containing its relationship source and target nodes and matches relationship directed exactly
